criterion.derivation: collision between his backstory (drives the transit route weekly, never cared how the tollhouse dispute ended) and the sample's own toll_ledger_arrears (an unresolved dispute that could disrupt the very road he depends on)

history.note: re-derived after encodings.json gained three new concrete concepts (crossing_market_roof, toll_ledger_arrears, forliamus_betrothal_offer) via /tell, at the author's explicit direction, to diversify arcs away from the epistemic-conflict default

routines.routine_actions: drives a caravan up and down the transit route on a fixed weekly schedule, pays the toll without comment, changes the subject whenever the old dispute comes up

arc.premise: Now that the arrears themselves are being chased down, Mekestros wants the recovered toll money actually spent on fixing the worst-rutted stretch of road near the tollhouse - not swallowed into some other account the way a promise like that usually goes. He's started buttonholing every official who rides his route to ask who's actually responsible for the spending, not just the collecting.
